description:
Drops the restore session and its unpacked files. A session that has already expired is not an error. A session from a page import is cancelled by its importer; a Settings session by its administrator.
Needs: an administrator for a stored backup (a token needs its Administrator switch); the importer for a page import

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Restore token returned by the inspect call

200.description: true when the session is gone
